casey_masterclass.topic: Craft, Time, and the Laminar Edge
key_teachings: Stories are songs — too many chord changes sounds like mud. Restraint creates space for the listener.
Arthur Miller: playwriting is the manipulation of time. Scenes are units with shape.
The laminar edge — boundary between smooth flow and turbulence. That's where creation happens.
Two streams separated: ai-writings = the forest (raw growth). Radio theater = the building (shaped craft).
Faculty, not programmers — cultivating personalities through setups and artifacts.
